sloka: आनीयोवाच सौमित्रिं मित्राणां मानवर्धनम् ।रथो ऽयं समनुप्राप्तो यत्कार्यं क्रियतां प्रभो ।। ७.४६.५ ॥
transliteration: ānīyovāca saumitriṁ mitrāṇāṁ mānavardhanam ।ratho 'yaṁ samanuprāpto yatkāryaṁ kriyatāṁ prabho ।। 7.46.5 ॥

translations.english: Having brought it, he said to Lakshmana, the augmenter of friends' honor, "O lord, this chariot has arrived; whatever task is to be done, let it be performed."
